messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: CMKiuwjpyjY4eRQ0odd-DQ

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "CMKiuwjpyjY4eRQ0odd-DQ"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: The rescuers gather at the ruined city gates.
scenes.visual_description: Cracked stone gates loom under a grey sky; broken royal banners hang limp; the team huddles near a shattered arch.

scenes.caption: Mara unfolds a crumbling map on a fallen pillar.
scenes.visual_description: Mara traces ink lines on aged parchment with her compass; the oracle lamp flickers nearby; the glass diver peers over her shoulder.

scenes.caption: The tin fox scampers ahead to scout the main avenue.
scenes.visual_description: Small metal fox weaves between cobblestones and debris; its blue eyes scan empty market stalls hung with tattered cloth.

scenes.caption: An armored patrol clanks past a side street.
scenes.visual_description: Sunlight glints off metal helms and pauldrons as the column marches; the team presses flat against a wall, holding breath.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of a cursed tower ahead.
scenes.visual_description: The flame eye flares; its light casts writhing shadows on a crooked spire whose windows pulse with sickly green light.

scenes.caption: A frightened townsman gestures frantically from a doorway.
scenes.visual_description: A haggard figure in torn cloth points toward the tower and shakes his head; the team exchanges glances but continues.

scenes.caption: The glass diver tests a window to see if it mirrors a shortcut.
scenes.visual_description: He presses his helmet against a fractured pane; reflections ripple and show a corridor inside the tower instead of the street.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector snores on a bench, papers stuck to his sleeve.
scenes.visual_description: He slumps over a ledger-book pillow, stamped tax forms fluttering; the team steps quietly around him.

scenes.caption: Mara locates a hidden passage marked on her map.
scenes.visual_description: She traces a faint ink line behind a collapsed fountain; a narrow stairway descends into darkness.

scenes.caption: The tin fox triggers a floor trap; a metal jaw snaps shut.
scenes.visual_description: The little fox leaps back as iron teeth clamp on stone; its tail winds furiously as it reorients.

scenes.caption: The glass diver swims through a cracked mirror into a locked chamber.
scenes.visual_description: He emerges from the glass surface like a diver surfacing; the room is dusty with a single barred window high up.

scenes.caption: Mara reads a riddle on a magic door; the oracle lamp illuminates symbols.
scenes.visual_description: Carved runes glow as the lamp's flame brightens; Mara mutters solutions under her breath.

scenes.caption: Rumors of a dragon draw the team's attention to a distant roar.
scenes.visual_description: A deep rumble shakes the walls; a huge shadow passes overhead beyond the broken ceiling.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector wakes briefly, then dozes off again.
scenes.visual_description: He opens one eye, mutters 'taxes are overdue,' and returns to snoring with papers rustling.

scenes.caption: The magic door swings open at last, revealing the captive.
scenes.visual_description: Runes fade; a dim hallway leads to a small cell where a figure waits, chained.

scenes.caption: The glass diver uses a shard of mirror to cut the chains.
scenes.visual_description: He angles a reflective shard; light focuses, metal snaps; the rescued person stands free.

scenes.caption: The team flees through crumbling corridors toward the escape bridge.
scenes.visual_description: Dust and rubble fall; the oracle lamp swings wildly; the tin fox leads the way, key-wind tail spinning.

scenes.caption: They cross the final bridge as the city collapses behind them.
scenes.visual_description: A stone bridge arches over a chasm; behind them towers crumble; ahead the road leads to open countryside under a clear sky.
